'''RA-7-D''' was a [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] which acted as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] and [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He believed that he was in love with a [[Unidentified medical droid (RA-7-D)|medical droid]], although it was unknown if this is due to a [[Programmer|programming]] glitch or a form of emergent behavior. RA-7-D also believed that the best way to demonstrate this love was to blow up [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] targets, preferably in a showy fashion.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
RA-7-D is one of the pre-generated characters from the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Beta|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Beta]]
